Ma'am @SushmaSwaraj 
We expect @mjakbar to be sacked as soon as possible in view of multiple charges, of sexual and behavioral misconduct, against him. A strong message needs to be given to all predators.

Cc: @narendramodi 
#SexualHarassment #MeTooIndia #MeToo #MJAkbar

Hope all of you are following the #metoo stories flooding in ,via social media, for quite sometime now. I've been following and i think everyone should, especially we youngsters.
These stories are an eye opener. These tell us the dark truth of our workspaces, our men women (1/3)

and our society at large.
Most of us actually want to see a change in society , want to see women fearless and independent, however we, especially men, have little idea of how worse the situation actually is. So to get an idea follow these stories.
#metoo stories tell (2/3)
